priceSnapshot.note: This report closes a 41.5-hour blind gap. The last session on record is 2026-08-22 endday at 77,283.3; no Sunday session ran at all and no midnight ran today, so there is no midnight file to compare against and the reference is the 22 August endday. What happened inside that gap is the whole story. Price flushed 1,723.8 points to 75,559.5 at 05:00Z Sunday, broke the 76,515.0 shelf that had held four consecutive sessions, reclaimed it within four hours, and then ran 4,440.3 points to tag 79,999.8 - twenty cents short of a round 80,000 - before settling here. changePct of 2.16 is the true rolling 24h figure measured against the OKX open24h of 77,318.7. Measured from the 22 August endday mark instead, spot is up 1,707.1 points or 2.21 percent.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close below $77,755.70, the 15m EMA200. Spot sits 1,234.7 points above it, which is 1.68 hourly ATRs, so one ordinary hour does not reach it. This level is chosen deliberately over the tighter 1H EMA20 at 78,215.19: that line is only 775 points away, inside a single hourly range, and this desk has twice logged the criticism that gates placed inside the session's own noise get wicked rather than confirmed. 77,755.70 sits below the entire Monday range and a close through it says the reclaim of 76,515.0 was a liquidity grab rather than a real base.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close above $79,999.80 - the exact high of the last 24 hours, printed at 15:00Z and rejected to the tick, twenty cents short of a round 80,000. That is not a coincidence, it is a resting-order shelf. A settled close through it converts the largest psychological level of this advance from resistance into support, and there is 1.05m of cleared leverage stacked in the 80,000 bucket to fuel the move.

decisionBox.changed: Position flips from TAKE_PROFIT back to ADD, and the reasoning is a failed breakdown rather than momentum-chasing. Four verified changes since the 22 August endday. FIRST, the reduce gate fired and then failed: 76,515.0 broke on four consecutive settled 1H closes (76,060.4 / 76,099.7 / 75,996.5 / 76,480.0, Sunday 05:00Z through 08:00Z) with a low of 75,559.5, and price then reclaimed the level and made a new high. A breakdown that reverses that completely is a stronger signal than a shelf that simply holds. SECOND, positioning de-crowded exactly as the endday report predicted it would need to: the OKX long/short account ratio has fallen from 1.17 to 1.01, dead neutral. THIRD, funding is 0.00772 percent, BELOW the 0.01 percent neutral baseline for the first time in this advance, so longs are no longer paying to be long. FOURTH, open interest is 2.325bn against 2.297bn at endday - up 1.2 percent while price rose 2.21 percent, meaning the move was carried by spot rather than by fresh leverage. The counterweight is unchanged and is why the size is small: the UTC-daily RSI has printed 85.81, higher than Saturday's 84.56 and the highest of the entire advance, and spot is 12.48 percent above the daily EMA20 at 70,225.69. A resting stop is NOT recommended this run - unlike the endday call, the next report is roughly six hours away with US markets open the whole time, not a blind overnight window.

liquidityMagnet.note: Pull is DOWN, but read the MAGNITUDE, because it has changed character completely since Saturday. Below spot the record holds 7.55m across the 78,750 / 78,500 / 78,250 / 78,000 / 77,750 buckets; above it, 4.66m across 79,250 / 79,500 / 79,750 / 80,000 / 80,250. That is 1.6 times more cleared leverage underneath. On Saturday the same measurement was 4.5-to-1 and the realized long-to-short ratio was 4.6-to-1; today it is 1.6-to-1 and 1.44-to-1. The book is far more two-sided than it was, which is what a genuine flush-and-reclaim does. The standing caveat still applies: realized liquidations are backward-looking and tell you where stops WERE, not where they are now. The forward inference here is milder than Saturday's precisely because the asymmetry is milder.

divergences.note: Price made a higher high of 2,235.2 points between the 22 August range top and Sunday's 79,999.8 tag, while the 4H MACD histogram went the other way - from -16.21 at the 22 August midday reading to -226.41 now, a fourteen-fold deepening. The oscillator peaked before the price peak and has not recovered on the new high. This is the clearest bearish signal in the report and it is the reason biasTilt is bearish inside a bullish overall bias.

Not a classic divergence - RSI made a higher high alongside price - but recorded because the LEVEL is the signal. 85.81 is the highest daily RSI of the entire advance from the 62,984.7 base on 13 August, and readings above 85 have historically resolved through time or price rather than continuing to expand. Logged as bearish context, not as a trade trigger.

calibration.actingHelped: Mixed, and the split is instructive. The 22 August endday flipped to TAKE_PROFIT, trimmed 10 percent of the spot core at 77,283.3, and recommended a resting stop at 76,480.0 for the overnight window. The WARNING was correct and specific: it named the Sunday thin-liquidity window, named 76,515.0, and said the gap between a close-based rule and an unwatched market was the reason to rest a stop. Price then flushed to 75,559.5 at 05:00Z Sunday - through the shelf, through the stop, and 955.5 points below the gate - on four consecutive settled 1H closes (76,060.4 / 76,099.7 / 75,996.5 / 76,480.0). So reduce_fired is TRUE and the thesis was vindicated. The EXECUTION is where it goes wrong. The flush reversed completely within four hours and price is now 78,990.4, which is 1,707.1 points ABOVE the trim and 3,430.9 points above the low. A stop resting at 76,480.0 would have sold the exact bottom of a failed breakdown. The trim itself cost little because it was deliberately sized at only 10 percent - that restraint is the part worth keeping. The lesson to carry: this desk's read of WHERE risk sits has been good three sessions running, but a wick-stop parked under a shelf that has been defended repeatedly is paying full price for insurance against the one outcome that shelf is designed to prevent.
